purpose: Teach: 声援/町民/趙/マメ/穂/山々/見所/７つ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが運動会で声援を一番大きく送って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father cheered the loudest for you at the sports day.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender pride in the observation. Voice lifts gently on 'loudest' — sharing something sweet she noticed. Intimate with Sho, the way a mother tells her child about their father's love.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと町民運動会に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the town sports day with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Opening word reaches toward her attention. Slight breathlessness — the excitement of having something to report. Small and genuine, the way he shares rather than performs.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「中国の趙さんから手紙が来た」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned he got a letter from Zhao in China.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently curious. Slight pause after 'Sho' — giving him space to listen. Voice carries the weight of her observing this detail, wondering if it matters to him. Reflective but warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「マメに連絡してね」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to stay in touch with him — keep in contact.
lines.style: Earnest delivery, the words careful. Small voice but solid conviction. He's processing an instruction that feels important, repeating it the way children do when they want to get it right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「稲穂が頭を垂れる秋」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said something about autumn — when the rice ear bows its head.
lines.style: Measured, poetic. She's translating something her husband said with reverence, not rushing it. Soft, reflective pacing. The tone of someone passing along a small wisdom.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと山々の絶景を観に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went with Dad to see the mountain views — the scenery was amazing.
lines.style: Energized opening, eager to paint the picture. Voice rises slightly on 'amazing.' Breathless from the memory of beauty and the joy of experiencing it with his father. The earnestness of a child who witnessed something real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ここがこの庭の見所」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father showed you the special parts of the garden — the things worth seeing.
lines.style: Gentle pride in the teaching moment. Voice softens slightly — she's noticing how her husband passes on his eye for beauty. Reflective but warm, the tone of a woman watching her son learn from his father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんからプレゼントを７つ頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad gave me seven presents.
lines.style: Bright, almost amazed delight. Opening syllable pops with joy. Quick pace, eager — the simple wonder of a six-year-old counting blessings. Pure, unguarded happiness in the delivery.
